描述_EN: this figure was originally painted using colours obtained from only three pigments - azurite, vermillion and copper green. instead of mixing pigments, craftsmen produced further shades by using underpaints. white paint and coloured pigments are visible on the surface of the wood.
描述_ZN: 此图最初只用三种颜料--天青石、朱红和铜绿--绘制而成。 工匠们没有混合颜料，而是通过使用底漆来产生更多的色调。 木头的表面可以看到白色的油漆和彩色的颜料。
